hero.imageAlt: Kiwanis Annual Community Pancake Day - families and volunteers at Jim Barnett Park
hero.title: Community Pancake Day
hero.lede: Every spring, Winchester gathers at Jim Barnett Park for a literal ton of sausage, thousands of pancakes, and a morning that funds local grants, scholarships, and youth programs.
hero.note: Spring 2026 was held April 25 at Jim Barnett Park War Memorial Building. Next date TBD - follow us on Facebook for announcements.

event.statusBanner: The April 25, 2026 event has concluded. Children 3 and under ate free, guests brought non-perishable food donations, and proceeds supported local children and families.
event.location: Jim Barnett Park War Memorial Building, 1001 E Cork St, Winchester, VA 22601
